scenes.say: A second clash in three weeks. What's up with Hamilton and Leclerc?
Mexico, lap one. Hamilton and Leclerc go wheel to wheel, and both Ferraris run off the track.
No contact, but Verstappen gets past Hamilton and wins.
Leclerc gets five seconds. Hamilton finishes second, Leclerc fourth.
Hamilton wants serious talks. Vasseur calls it a lack of respect.
Before Brazil, Vasseur sits them down. He says they left joking.
Vegas, lap thirty-eight. A dive up the inside, and Hamilton is spun.
The stewards blame Leclerc: ten seconds. Hamilton finishes seventh.
Leclerc apologises. Vasseur: unacceptable, same message as Mexico.
Ferrari are second in the constructors', with only seven points from Vegas.

title: Hamilton and Leclerc: three flashpoints in a month and what Ferrari said about them
